project.description: Packages the query service image from the per-stack reactor lane and ships the tarball to the stack's S3 prefix. Requires a prior successful 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' for the same TARGET_STACK.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -e
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}"
MAVEN_WS="/var/jenkins_home/workspace/PIC-SURE Maven Build - ${TARGET_STACK}"
# Guard: this job does not compile; it needs the reactor's artifacts for THIS stack. if [ ! -f "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt" ] || ! ls "$MAVEN_WS"/services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service/target/pic-sure-hpds-query-service-*.jar >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: no reactor artifacts for stack ${TARGET_STACK} -- run 'PIC-SURE Maven Build' first" exit 2 fi . "$MAVEN_WS/build-info.txt"
docker build --load \ -t "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-query-service:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" \ "$MAVEN_WS/services/pic-sure-hpds-query-service/"
docker save "hms-dbmi/pic-sure-hpds-query-service:${GIT_BRANCH_SHORT}_${GIT_COMMIT_SHORT}" | gzip > pic-sure-hpds-query-service.tar.gz aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp pic-sure-hpds-query-service.tar.gz "s3://$S3_BUCKET_NAME/$TARGET_STACK/containers/pic-sure-hpds-query-service.tar.gz"
